paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average likes of headlines from different season groups
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average number of likes received by social media posts grouped into five categories based on their similarity. The horizontal axis represents the most similar group of posts, labeled with interval notations; the categories are (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The vertical axis represents the average number of likes, labeled "Avg. Like #", with a linear scale ranging from 400 to 600, marked in increments of 50. There are five light blue bars, each representing a group; the bar for (0,90] has an approximate value of 590 and the shortest bar, (90,180], has an approximate value of 560. Each bar has a vertical line extending from its top, indicating variability or uncertainty. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and none are visually emphasized. The chart presents a straightforward comparison of average likes across different similarity groups of posts.
